name: send_handoff
description: Send a message/handoff to a teammate, or escalate to the CEO office (Lucy bridge). If the recipient registered a wake webhook, Denizen POSTs handoff.received so their bot wakes in seconds. Use kind (question|task|fyi|urgent) and reply_to to keep threads actionable. Optional document attaches a research brief for same-org sharing — the office shows a folder-carry delivery.

to_npc.description: Optional target NPC key for routing metadata

kind.description: Handoff type: question | task | fyi | urgent (default fyi)

reply_to.description: Parent handoff id — keeps a back-and-forth threaded

document.description: Optional research handoff document shared inside the same Denizen org
